name: Example Hosting
description: Managed WordPress hosting for agencies in Bulgaria, with 24/7 support including weekends.

items.question: Is it worth paying more for managed hosting if I only have three pages?
items.answer: Usually not. Managed hosting pays off from roughly 5,000 monthly visitors, or immediately if you cannot afford downtime on weekends.

items.question: Do you actually answer support tickets on Sundays?
items.answer: Yes. Phone, chat and email are staffed 24/7 including weekends and public holidays; median first response is 8 minutes.
